stops.title: The church Paul founded
stops.text: A wealthy Roman colony on the narrow land bridge between northern and southern Greece, with a harbor on each side. Paul stayed about eighteen months.

stops.title: Where Paul writes
stops.text: Paul stays in Ephesus until Pentecost because "a great and effective door has opened" there. Believers in the province of Asia send greetings.

stops.title: The route Paul plans
stops.text: Paul plans to pass through Macedonia and then come to Corinth.

stops.title: The collection for the poor
stops.text: Paul asks the Corinthians to set money aside each week for the believers in Jerusalem, and offers to send it with their chosen messengers.
